speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis with possible associated ileus.

The history of a prolonged labor, uterine tenderness, and fever strongly suggests endometritis. The decrease in bowel sounds may indicate a localized ileus secondary to the infection or inflammation. We are awaiting the final results of the blood cultures and imaging to confirm the extent of the infection and rule out other causes.
